workbook.title: The Dancer Mindset
workbook.summary: An original demonstration workbook about showing up, finding your footing, and practicing with intention.

blocks.body:
Before the music begins, notice where you are today. Your starting position can change from one practice to the next. Take a moment to name what you have available: energy, curiosity, a little time, or simply the willingness to begin.

Pick one small thing to pay attention to as you move. It could be your breath, the shift of weight in your feet, or the moment you notice yourself rushing.

blocks.prompt: What do you notice about how you’re arriving at practice today?
Which cue would help you begin?

options.label: Feel where my feet meet the floor
Listen for the rhythm before moving

blocks.prompt: How ready do you feel to start a short practice?

content.title: Make room for a second try

blocks.body: Think of a phrase you lost halfway through. On a second try, give yourself one specific experiment: slow the transition, mark the steps, or return to the last count you remember. When you finish, write down what changed.

blocks.prompt: Which part of a recent practice would you revisit, and what would you try differently?

blocks.body: Choose a practice you could repeat on an ordinary day. Five minutes with a familiar track is enough to start. Decide when and where you’ll do it, and make the first step small enough to take even if your day changes.

blocks.prompt: What practice will you repeat, and what’s the first step you’ll take?
